test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1 **i.e. **engage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about the importance of participating in meaningful activities to promote social justice, challenge biases, and foster diversity.
 
• "**Engage**" appropriately fits the context of actively participating in dialogue and initiatives.
 
• The phrase** "engage in meaningful dialogue"** is commonly used to convey active involvement in discussions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **engage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: coincide. **This means to occur at the same time, which does not fit the context of participating in dialogue and actions.
 
• **Option 3: evolve. **This means to develop gradually, which does not directly relate to participating in dialogue or actions.
 
• **Option 4: manifest.** This means to display or show, which does not fit the context of actively participating in meaningful dialogue.
